base.data: native OKX futures and marks; no pre-2024

stages: Unchanged upstream baseline on supplied 100-pair universe
Official-static intersection with supplied universe (40-80 recommended range); original parameter defaults
Mechanism controls on same pair universe: 1x leverage, no position adjustment, 12 slots
Cost stress: double per-side fee; describe execution and missing funding separately
Attribution by campaign, direction, tag family, pair, exit reason, calendar month; realized and mark-to-market drawdown; DCA and capital exposure
selection: Do not select best coins/tags using full-period profits. Any tuned changes are exploratory. July-August development and September-October temporal comparison, with known present-day universe bias. No claim of independent OOS.
success: Net portfolio profit including forced end exits, costs disclosed, risk and concentration reported; high win rate alone is insufficient.
additional_control: Replay documented age>=60 days and 3 closed daily range 0.03-0.95 on static official intersection; fixed official thresholds, not optimized. Does not restore historical volume ranking.

holding_limit_control.clock: first entry, not latest add or partial exit
holding_limit_control.unchanged: signal generation, universe, leverage, fees and pre-deadline management
holding_limit_control.validation: all completed campaigns <=1440 minutes; audit all forced exits, order cashflows and whole-wallet P&L; not removal of long-duration trades
